title: This Free AI Predicts Exactly How the Public Will React to Anything
description:
There's a project going viral on GitHub right now — and it's called Miro Fish.

Here's what it does:

Upload any document — a press release, policy draft, or earnings report — and it builds a knowledge graph, spins up hundreds of AI agents with unique personalities, and simulates their social media reactions in real time.

You're basically seeing the future before it happens.

Here's how people are already using it:

📣 PR teams — Test public reaction before posting anything publicly

📈 Traders — Predict market sentiment on breaking news before it moves

🎯 Prediction markets — Get an edge by simulating crowd reaction before placing a bet

Originally built in Chinese, but someone already made a fully offline English version you can run on your own computer. No cloud. No API fees.

Comment "fish" and I'll send you the link 👇
